fields.label: Enable Shopware 6 integration
fields.description: Enables the connection to Shopware. Disabled: no sync, no webhook processing. Only enable once the connection has been tested.

fields.options:
Willkommen bei der Shopware-6-Integration

Diese Einstellungen verbinden Ihren ERPNext-Mandanten mit einem Shopware-6-Shop. Bitte in dieser Reihenfolge vorgehen:

  1. Verbindung – Shop-URL und Zugangsdaten eintragen, dann Verbindung testen.
  2. Storefronts – Storefronts aktualisieren klicken und gewünschte Kanäle aktivieren.
  3. Firma & Kunden – Standard-Firma, Standardkunde, Standardlager hinterlegen.
  4. Bestellungen – Nummernkreise und Belegautomatik einstellen.
  5. Produkt-Upload – erst Vorschau anzeigen, dann Jetzt synchronisieren.
  6. Integration aktivieren – ganz oben den Haken setzen.

Alle gefährlichen Schalter (z. B. Produkt-Upload, automatische Rechnungserstellung) sind standardmäßig aus. Bitte jeden Schalter erst nach einem Trockenlauf einschalten.

fields.label: Storefronts (sales channels)
fields.description: Liste aller in Shopware vorhandenen Storefronts. Pro Storefront kann separat festgelegt werden, ob ERPNext-Artikel dorthin synchronisiert werden.
Storefronts fetched from Shopware. Reload via the button below.
fields.label: Available storefronts
Category sync (ERP → shop)
fields.description: Mirrors the ERPNext item-group tree 1:1 into Shopware categories. One entry per storefront × root item group.

fields.options:
Catalog Mirror reflects the ERPNext Item Group tree 1:1 into Shopware's category tree. One Mirror per (storefront × root Item Group). The Mirror creates / updates / re-parents Shopware categories so they match your ERP structure; the Item-to-Category linking happens automatically at product-export time based on each item's item_group.

Use this for your standard category structure. Use Smart Collections (below) for rule-based ad-hoc groupings (Sale, Bestseller, etc.) that don't follow the Item Group tree.

Browse all under Catalog Mirrors.

fields.label: Eigene Kollektionen (Sale, Bestseller, …)
fields.description: Rule-based collections that don't fall out of the item-group tree (e.g. Sale, Bestsellers, seasonal promotions).

fields.options:
Smart Collections are for rule-based ad-hoc groupings that don't follow the ERPNext Item Group tree — Sale, Bestseller, Outdoor & Wasserdicht, Black Friday, etc. Each collection's rules resolve to an item set; the Shopware category and its items are managed by the sync.

For your standard category structure (one-to-one with Item Groups) use Catalog Mirror (above) instead.

Browse all under Smart Collections.

fields.label: Produkt-Sync (ERP → Shop)
fields.description: Configurable Product Syncs (Ecommerce Product Sync). One entry per scope (storefront × item group / filter). Preview, sandbox push, and Apply Live all run against the Sync — not against these settings.

fields.label: Pull Sync (Shop → ERP)
fields.description: Incoming syncs (orders / customers / stock from Shopware to ERPNext). One cron interval per Pull Sync; manual run via the button below.

fields.label: Full sync (advanced)
fields.description: Options for the manual full reconciliation. These settings only apply to the full sync, not regular operation.

fields.label: Skip category sync during full sync
fields.description: When enabled, the full sync skips phase 1 (categories) and only syncs items. Useful when the categories are already up to date.

fields.label: Massen-Synchronisation (Performance)
fields.description: Shields ERPNext from overload when many item changes happen in a short time. Fast changes are collected and processed in batches.
Recommended: enabled. When many items change in quick succession, the changes are queued and pushed to Shopware in batches. Prevents load spikes and timeouts.
fields.label: Enable bulk synchronisation

fields.description: Threshold of item changes within 2 seconds at which the bulk mode kicks in.
fields.label: Schwellenwert Massen-Modus

fields.description: Anzahl Artikel, die pro Stapel verarbeitet werden.
fields.label: Batch size

fields.description: Admin password for API access. Stored encrypted.

Webhooks (incoming events)
fields.description: Webhooks let Shopware notify ERPNext of events (e.g. new order) instantly — faster than periodic polling.
Secret used to verify incoming webhooks. MANDATORY in production. Configure the same value in Shopware's webhook setup.
fields.label: Webhook secret

fields.description: SECURITY WARNING: Only enable for local testing. ALWAYS leave disabled in production and set a webhook secret instead — otherwise anyone with the URL can inject data.
fields.label: Unsignierte Webhooks zulassen (nicht empfohlen)
Webhook-URL
fields.options:
Webhooks im Shopware-Admin konfigurieren unter Einstellungen → Erweiterungen → Webhooks.
Folgende URL eintragen:
/api/method/ecommerce_integrations.shopware6.connection.webhook_handler

Hinweis: Webhooks erfordern die Shopware Evolve Edition. Für andere Editionen das ERPNext Webhook Plugin installieren.

Customer group new customers from Shopware are assigned to.

fields.description: Auf welche Firma, welches Konto und welche Kostenstelle Shopware-Bestellungen gebucht werden.

fields.label: Preise (B2B / B2C)
fields.description: Which price list is pushed to Shopware and how gross/net prices are handled. Note: B2B shops typically use net prices, B2C shops gross prices.
Default price list for product export. Used as a baseline for storefront-specific prices and as a fallback when no per-storefront price list is set.
fields.label: Standard-Verkaufspreisliste

fields.description: Enable if the default price list contains gross prices (incl. VAT). Prices are converted to net before syncing to Shopware.
fields.label: Default price list contains gross prices

fields.description: Price list for MSRP / strike-through prices. When an item is priced higher here than in the sales price list, the MSRP is pushed to Shopware as listPrice (strike-through).
fields.label: UVP-/Streichpreisliste

fields.description: Enable if the MSRP price list contains gross prices. Prices are converted to net before being sent to Shopware.
fields.label: MSRP price list contains gross prices

fields.description: Recommended for B2B: prices from Shopware are stored as net prices. When disabled (B2C), they remain as gross prices (incl. VAT).
fields.label: Preise als Netto importieren (B2B)
Price Handling Info
fields.options:
Price Handling

B2B Mode (Net Prices): Shopware stores gross prices. When importing, gross is converted to net using the tax rate from the order. Taxes are added separately.

B2C Mode (Gross Prices): Prices are imported as-is from Shopware (gross/inclusive of VAT).

German Law: B2B invoices typically show net prices + VAT. B2C invoices show gross prices including VAT.

fields.label: Bestellungen (Eingang aus Shopware)
fields.description: How often orders are fetched from Shopware and which naming series are used for orders, delivery notes, and invoices.
How often orders are fetched from Shopware (in minutes). Smaller values = more current, but more load.
fields.label: Bestell-Sync-Intervall (Minuten)
Letzter Bestell-Sync (informativ)
fields.description: Timestamp of the last successful order pull. Informational only.

fields.label: Order confirmation naming series
fields.description: Naming series for order confirmations created from Shopware orders.

fields.label: Nummernkreis Lieferschein
fields.description: Naming series for delivery notes created from Shopware shipments.

fields.label: Nummernkreis Rechnung
fields.description: Naming series for invoices created from Shopware payments.

fields.label: Lieferscheine aus Shopware-Sendungen erstellen
fields.description: When enabled: ERPNext automatically creates a delivery note as soon as a shipment is created in Shopware. Disabled: delivery notes must be created manually.

fields.label: Rechnung automatisch bei Versand erstellen (empfohlen)
fields.description: Compliant with German law: auto-creates an invoice as soon as the delivery note is submitted. Invoice date = shipment date. IMPORTANT: When disabled, you must create invoices manually.

fields.label: Create invoices for paid orders
fields.description: Creates an invoice as soon as payment is confirmed in Shopware. For prepay mail-order: often the second step after 'Invoice on shipment'.

fields.label: Rechnung automatisch per E-Mail versenden
fields.description: Sends the invoice as a PDF to the customer's email as soon as payment is confirmed. Check the print format and email template before enabling.

fields.label: Druckformat Rechnung
fields.description: Print format used for the invoice PDF attachment.

fields.label: Invoice email template
fields.description: Optional email template. Without a selection, a neutral default text is used.

fields.label: Zahlungsart-Zuordnung
fields.description: Welche Shopware-Zahlart welcher ERPNext-Zahlungsart entspricht (z.B. Stripe → Stripe-Konto, PayPal → PayPal-Konto). Ohne Zuordnung wird die Standard-Zahlungsart unten verwendet.

fields.options:
Map Shopware payment methods (technical short names) to ERPNext Modes of Payment. Lookup order:

  1. Exact match in this table (case-insensitive).
  2. Partial match in this table.
  3. Built-in defaults shipped with the plugin.
  4. The Default Mode of Payment below.

If none of the above resolves to an existing Mode of Payment, the order is created without a Mode of Payment.

fields.description: Used when none of the mappings above match. Without a selection, the ERPNext default payment method is used.
fields.label: Standard-Zahlungsart
MwSt.-Konten
fields.description: Auf welche ERPNext-Konten die in Shopware berechnete Mehrwertsteuer gebucht wird.

fields.options: Shopware-MwSt.-Sätze und Versandkosten den passenden ERPNext-Konten zuordnen.

fields.description: Fallback account when no specific VAT-rate mapping is found.
fields.label: Standard-Umsatzsteuerkonto

fields.description: Konto, auf das Versandkosten aus Shopware-Bestellungen gebucht werden.
fields.label: Standardkonto Versandkosten
Produkt-Upload (ERPNext → Shopware)
fields.description: Whether and how items are pushed from ERPNext to Shopware. CAUTION: These settings can overwrite existing Shopware data. Always run a dry-run before enabling.

fields.label: Upload ERPNext items to Shopware
fields.description: DANGEROUS: Enables outbound sync. Every new item and every item change is pushed to Shopware. WARNING: If you edit product copy directly in Shopware, it will be overwritten on the next ERPNext save. Run a full dry-run first to see the impact.

fields.label: Automatically push item changes to Shopware
fields.description: When enabled: every item change is pushed to Shopware immediately. When disabled: sync only happens manually per item via the 'Sync now' button. Operators who often edit copy in Shopware should leave this off.

fields.label: Publish new items as active in Shopware
fields.description: When enabled: newly uploaded items are visible in the shop immediately. When disabled (recommended): items are created as inactive and have to be released manually in Shopware.

fields.label: Export template (parent) items as inactive
fields.description: Recommended: enabled. Template items with variants are created inactive in Shopware; only the variants are visible. Prevents duplicate hits in the product list.

fields.label: Discount item
fields.description: Dummy item (e.g. 'DISCOUNT') used to insert Shopware promo discounts into the order. Recorded with a negative amount.

fields.label: Versandkosten
fields.description: How shipping costs from Shopware orders are recorded in ERPNext. Recommended: as a separate line item via a service product (e.g. 'SHIPPING').

fields.label: Record shipping as a line item
fields.description: Recommended: enabled. Adds shipping as its own line item on the order. Required for shipping costs to be picked up from Shopware.

fields.label: Versand-Artikel
fields.description: ERPNext item for shipping costs (e.g. 'SHIPPING'). Inserted as a line item whenever shipping costs apply.

fields.label: Shipping Info
fields.options:
Shipping Cost Handling

When enabled, shipping costs from Shopware orders are added as a separate line item using the configured Shipping Item.

Note: Make sure to create a service item (e.g., 'VERSAND') with appropriate tax settings.

fields.label: Category sync (legacy settings)
fields.description: Legacy global category-sync settings. For new setups please use the modern category sync (above). These values are used only as a fallback.

fields.label: Root item group for category sync
fields.description: Root category for the Shopware sync. All sub-categories below are synced.

fields.label: Don't sync the root category itself
fields.description: When enabled: the root category itself isn't created in Shopware — only its children.

fields.label: Sync empty categories
fields.description: When enabled: categories without items are still pushed to Shopware.

fields.label: Protected Shopware category IDs
fields.description: Shopware category IDs (one per line) that are never auto-deleted, even if they look 'orphaned'. These categories and their sub-categories are protected. Useful for categories maintained directly in Shopware.

fields.label: Category Sync Info
fields.options:
Category Sync

Categories are synced from ERPNext to Shopware in tree order (parent before children).

Tip: Use 'Sync All Categories' button to sync all categories at once, or use 'Full Reconciliation' to sync both categories and products.

fields.label: Batch sizes for the full sync
fields.description: How many rows per pass. Larger values = faster but more RAM. The default is usually fine.
Anzahl Artikel pro Stapel beim Komplett-Sync.
fields.label: Item batch size

fields.description: Anzahl Preise pro Stapel beim Preis-Sync.
fields.label: Price batch size

fields.description: Number of template items with variants per batch.
fields.label: Variant batch size
Field mappings (advanced)
fields.description: Which ERPNext item fields are pushed to Shopware — and whether as a Custom Field (not filterable) or as a Property (filterable in the shop).

fields.label: Feld-Zuordnungen
fields.description: ERPNext-Artikel-Felder auf Shopware-Produkt-Felder abbilden (Custom Field oder Eigenschaft).

fields.label: jattr_*-Felder automatisch erkennen
fields.description: Synchronisiert alle benutzerdefinierten jattr_*-Felder automatisch als Shopware-Eigenschaften (filterbar).

fields.label: Field Mapping Info
fields.options:
Field Mapping Types
  • Custom Field: Synced to Shopware customFields (product detail page, not filterable)
  • Property: Synced as PropertyGroup/Option (filterable in shop frontend)
  • Standard Field: Maps to built-in Shopware product fields

Tip: Enable 'Auto-detect jattr_* fields' to automatically sync all JTL attributes as Properties.

Default warehouse used to report stock when no specific warehouse mapping matches.

Sync ERPNext stock levels to Shopware
fields.description: DANGEROUS: When enabled, ERPNext overwrites stock in Shopware periodically. Only enable if ERPNext is the source of truth for stock. If you also maintain stock in Shopware, those edits would be overwritten.

fields.label: Bestand-Sync-Intervall (Minuten)
fields.description: How often ERPNext stock is pushed to Shopware.

fields.label: Letzter Bestand-Sync (informativ)
fields.description: Timestamp of the last successful stock sync. Informational only.

fields.label: Checkout fields (advanced)
fields.description: How Shopware checkout fields (custom fields from the checkout flow) are mapped to ERPNext. One row per field.

fields.label: Checkout-Feld-Zuordnungen
fields.description: Welche Checkout-Felder verarbeitet und wie sie abgebildet werden.

fields.options:
Checkout-Felder erlauben, im Shopware-Checkout zusätzliche Eingaben (z.B. Lieferdatum, Wunschtermin, Bestell-Referenz) zu erfassen und in ERPNext zu spiegeln.

Pro Feld eine Zeile mit Custom-Field-Name aus Shopware und Ziel-Feld in ERPNext anlegen.
